event.description: Reduce projection-free model feed-forward width from 12 to 8
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 3,168 parameters at 99.940000%, a +0.940000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 8 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0012, ff_dim=7 with conventional output projections at 3,424 parameters and 99.18% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0011, ff_dim=6 under that architecture, an optimization failure reaching 98.65% internal validation without an official score. Attempt-0020 then established a projection-free attention architecture with ff_dim=12 and 99.94% official accuracy. Hypothesis: that architecture retains enough margin to reduce ff_dim 12->8, a parameterization-preserving compression removing 256 parameters and yielding 2,912. This is more informative than the nearest untested width 10 because it tests whether the previously viable half-width nonlinear state survives the major attention substitution.
